title: Toward a Multi-Embodied Grasping Agent
title_zh: 面向多具身抓取智能体
abstract: Multi-embodiment grasping aims to develop approaches that exhibit generalist behavior across diverse gripper designs. Existing methods often learn the gripper kinematic structure implicitly and face challenges due to the difficulty of sourcing the required large-scale data. In this work, we present a data-efficient, flow-based, equivariant grasp synthesis architecture that handles different gripper types with variable degrees of freedom and exploits the underlying kinematic model, deducing all necessary information solely from gripper and scene geometry. Unlike previous equivariant grasping methods, we implement all modules in JAX and provide batching capabilities over scenes, grippers, and grasps, resulting in smoother learning, improved performance, and faster inference. Our dataset encompasses grippers ranging from humanoid hands to parallel-jaw designs, including 25,000 scenes and 20 million grasps.
abstract_zh: 多具身抓取旨在开发能在多种夹爪设计上展现通用行为的方法。现有方法通常隐式学习夹爪运动学结构，并因难以获取所需大规模数据而面临挑战。在本工作中，我们提出了一种数据高效、基于流、等变的抓取合成架构，可处理不同自由度类型的夹爪，并利用底层运动学模型，仅从夹爪和场景几何中推导所有必要信息。与以往的等变抓取方法不同，我们在 JAX 中实现所有模块，并提供跨场景、夹爪和抓取的批处理能力，从而实现更平滑的学习、改进的性能和更快的推理。我们的数据集涵盖从人形手到平行夹爪设计的夹爪，包括 25,000 个场景和 2000 万次抓取。
tldr_zh: 提出数据高效等变抓取架构，支持多夹爪类型。
cover_zh: 告别手工调参｜这个等变架构让多夹爪抓取直接起飞
